{{Quote|I spoke to my friend at Five Hundred. She thinks they'll finish inspecting up there today.|Kellen to Brasso|<ref name="Sagrona Teema" />}}
A '''friend''' of the [[human]] [[merchant]] [[Kellen]] that resided at [[Council Five Hundred]] on the agricultural [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]]<ref name="Sagrona Teema" /> in [[4 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|2}}</ref> She spoke with Kellen during the [[Imperial Supply Census]] of Mina-Rau during which she informed him of the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial's]] activities and numbers.<ref name="Sagrona Teema" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kellen's friend was mentioned in the [[Sagrona Teema|second episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Sagrona Teema" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
